_doc: OBSIDIAN-INTELLIGENCE-MS3/D5/U-CONTEXT-EVAL-GATE golden expectation set. Each entry: when an agent's query token-matches `query`, the context it retrieved SHOULD contain every string in `requiredTokens` and every path in `requiredFiles`. Token matching is SOUND (post 2026-05-17 Arm-B P0-3 fix): a token counts as present only when it is a WHOLE token of the retrieved context (case-insensitive); compound identifiers containing a digit/`_`/`.` (e.g. `kc1_1`, `z.enum`, `constants.ts`) additionally allow a substring match. Plain short alphabetic tokens (`mc`,`ap`,`fz`,`fc`,`vc`) are intentional — they ARE standalone identifiers in physics text and now match only as whole tokens, not as accidental substrings. ContextEvalEngine scores coverage and the post-memory-context-eval PostToolUse hook surfaces a WARN/FAIL advisory on the just-retrieved context. Advisory only — never blocks (operator-in-the-loop). Extend manually or regenerate-check via `node scripts/context-eval-golden-check.mjs`; ids must be unique. Refresh `lastReviewed` whenever entries change so staleness is visible (the check script flags entries older than reviewIntervalDays).
